    "def load_frame(path: str) -> list[dict]:\n",
    "    \"\"\"JSON Lines を読む。\"\"\"\n",
    "    rows = []\n",
    "    for line in Path(path).read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\").splitlines():\n",
    "        rows.append(json.loads(line))\n",
    "    return rows\n",
    "\n",
    "frame = load_frame(\"data.jsonl\")"
   ]
